title: Tic-Tac-Toe in Wood – The Classic That Stays Out on the Table
descriptionHtml:
Game night dies in an app store

Everyone wants to do something together, but the games are in a box at the back of the closet and the phones are closer to hand.

The game that stays out and gets played

Wooden tic-tac-toe, 14.3 × 14.3 cm, with pieces that stay in their compartments. Nice enough for the coffee table, simple enough for the five-year-old and grandpa to play on equal terms.

Features

  • Playable by all ages right away – everyone already knows the rules
  • Stays out and gets used – wood that suits the coffee table
  • The pieces have their own compartments – no lid to find, nothing to lose
  • 14.3 cm wide – fits on the tray table, the balcony table and in a bag

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
